description:
Every economic series we hold — national statistics and the cash rate — with its latest value.
Use it to find a `series_id`, then fetch the history from
`/economics/series/{series_id}`.

Datasets: `cpi` (25 items incl. rents and new dwellings, 8 capitals +
national, monthly and quarterly), `cash-rate`, `mortgage-rates` (banks'
indicator rates), `wpi` (wages), `building-approvals` (states + capital
cities), `housing-lending` (owner-occupier, investor, first home buyers),
`population`, `labour-force` and `dwelling-transfers` (median prices and
counts by capital city).

**Price: 1¢ per call.**

dataset.description: One of: cpi, cash-rate, mortgage-rates, wpi, building-approvals, housing-lending, population, labour-force, dwelling-transfers.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the series id or title.

region.description: australia, a state (nsw, vic…), a capital city (sydney…) or greater-sydney style GCCSA.
